sections.title: No new tense needed yet
sections.content: Hungarian often just uses the present tense plus a clear future time word to talk about plans, instead of a separate future form: jövőre ("next year"), egy év múlva ("in a year"), nyáron ("in the summer") — the time word alone tells the listener you mean the future.

items.english: Next year I'll speak Hungarian fluently.
In the summer I'm going to a language school in Budapest.

sections.content: A dedicated future tense with fog is coming in a later unit — until then, present tense plus a clear time word like jövőre does the job for everyday plans.
